description: This image is not a scientific figure. It is a small publisher badge ("Check for updates") supplied by the article's production system, not a data panel from the Fe–30Mn–10Al–1.5C–xBe study. It consists of a circular icon above two lines of text on a light grey rounded-square background. The icon is built from two open ring arcs — one pale blue occupying the upper-right and right portion of the circle, one yellow occupying the lower-left and left portion — that together enclose a solid red bookmark/tag shape whose lower edge is notched into a downward point. Below the icon, the words "Check for updates" are set in dark grey/black sans-serif type over two centred lines, in a size comparable to the icon diameter. There are no axes, units, scale bars, legends, sample labels, or numeric values anywhere in the image, and nothing that refers to austenite, ferrite, beryllium content, rolling temperature or mechanical properties. The only text citable from the pixels is the string "Check for updates". Consequently this image provides no evidence about the microstructure or mechanical behaviour of the Fe–Mn–Al–C–Be low-density steels, and no association with any other panel can be drawn; it should not be linked to any data in the paper.
